acceptance_rule: Correctness, originality, and value must all pass.

correctness.reason: The fixed-action parametrization was reconstructed and the finite search was re-executed independently. It produced exactly 931 invariant squares. A separate exhaustive isotopy test on the reconstructed squares produced eight classes with class sizes 49, 294, 294, 98, 49, 49, 49, 49, matching the package. The inspected verifier also directly checks Latinness, action invariance, member-to-representative isotopies, pairwise non-isotopy of representatives, and order-7 autotopisms.
correctness.risks: The audit did not independently regenerate the large census.json byte-for-byte, but the theorem-level enumeration and classification were reconstructed from first principles.

final_claim: There are exactly eight isotopy classes of order-8 Latin squares admitting the fixed diagonal autotopism whose three components are a 7-cycle with one fixed point; the fixed-action census contains 931 labelled invariant squares.

originality.broader_coverage: Stones–Vojtěchovský–Wanless determine admissible cycle structures, an existence-level result rather than this census.
originality.claim_vs_prior_implication: Existence of the cycle structure and the total order-8 classification do not imply the count eight without an additional property-specific census.
originality.equivalent_formulations: Checked diagonal automorphism/autotopism terminology and isotopy-class formulations.
originality.exact_database_or_table: McKay–Meynert–Myrvold give aggregate order-8 class counts; no table found giving the order-7 diagonal stratum.
originality.reason: The closest primary literature classifies which cycle structures can occur as autotopisms and gives global small-order class counts, but the inspected statements do not tabulate this eight-class subset or the 931 fixed-action count. Searches of the published corpus returned the present result as the only direct match. McKay–Meynert–Myrvold tabulate total order-8 isotopy classes, not the requested symmetry stratum.
originality.risks: A non-indexed specialist database could in principle permit extraction of the same subset, but no published table or result located states it.

value.reason: This is a natural complete classification of a symmetry stratum inside the first order where the global isotopy universe is already very large. The exact class count and representatives are reusable structural data, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
value.risks: Value is primarily classificatory rather than theorem-generating.
